info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Portfolio Updates API
info.description: The Bank Portfolio Updates API facilitates dynamic modifications to banking portfolios, ensuring that clients can maintain accurate and current records. This endpoint allows users to adjust portfolio parameters, such as investment allocations or risk profiles, in response to market changes or client preferences. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts, portfolio managers, and banking software applications that require real-time updates to reflect client investment strategies. By utilizing the PATCH method, stakeholders can efficiently refine portfolio data without the need for complete data re-submission.
